instruction: Modify the formatting of the Internship Report and the Internship Evaluation Form separately according to the formatting requirements shown in the images. Only the formatting of the original documents may be modified. Finally, provide two editable Word documents.

dim1: The deliverables include 2 Word documents, corresponding respectively to the Graduation Internship Report and the Graduation Internship Evaluation Form, and both files can be opened normally.
dim2: +1: On page 1 of the Internship Report document, “Internship Report” is formatted in SimSun, No. 2, and bold.

+1: On page 1 of the Internship Report document, the text “Internship Organization: Herun Tongyue Kindergarten” and “Internship Dates: October 20, 2025 to December 26, 2025” is in SimSun, No. 4; the numerals are in Times New Roman, No. 4; and the text is center-aligned.
+1: On page 1 of the Internship Report document, the text “Report on Preschool Education Practice at Herun Tongyue Kindergarten” is formatted in SimHei, No. 3, and bold.
+1: On page 2 of the Internship Report document, the text “Title: Report on Preschool Education Practice at Herun Tongyue Kindergarten” is formatted in SimHei, No. 3, and bold.
+3: In the Internship Report document, headings with numbering formats such as “I.” and “II.” are formatted in SimHei, Small No. 3, and bold.
+3: In the Internship Report document, headings with numbering formats such as “(1)” and “(2)” are formatted in SimHei, No. 4, and bold.

+3: From page 2 onward in the Internship Report document, all text other than tables, headings, “Instructor’s Signature,” “Date,” and “Grade Assessment” is formatted in SimSun, No. 4, with a first-line indent of 2 characters and 1.1 line spacing.

+5: In the table in the Internship Evaluation Form document, all Chinese text in rows 1–4 and column 1 is formatted in SimSun, No. 4; numeric portions are formatted in Times New Roman, No. 4; the content is center-aligned and uses single line spacing.
+1: In the Internship Evaluation Form, the cell to the right of “Internship Organization Evaluation” uses SimSun, Small No. 4, single line spacing, and a first-line indent of 2 characters.
+1: In the Internship Evaluation Form, the cell to the right of “Academic Unit Evaluation Comments” uses SimSun, Small No. 4, single line spacing, and a first-line indent of 2 characters.
+1: In the Internship Evaluation Form, the cell to the right of “Self-Evaluation” uses SimSun, Small No. 4, single line spacing, and a first-line indent of 2 characters.
+1: In the Internship Evaluation Form, the text “Student ID” is arranged horizontally.
-1: The cover page of the Internship Report document does not contain an image 13–16 cm long and 3.5–5 cm wide.
-1: On the first page of the Internship Report document, spaces appear between the four Chinese characters in “Internship Report.”
-1: In the Internship Report document, the title, internship organization, and internship dates below the “Internship Report” heading are not arranged in that order.
-1: On the first page of the Internship Report document, neither “Jianghuai College of Arts and Sciences” nor “School of Humanities and Education” appears below “Internship Dates.”
-3: The Internship Report document does not contain “(2) Overview of the Internship Organization” and the four paragraphs of text below it.
-1: The top of the Internship Evaluation Form page does not contain the centered, bold text “Jianghuai College of Arts and Sciences Graduation Internship Evaluation Form” in SimHei, size 20.
-3: The Internship Evaluation Form does not contain exactly one table, or the table does not have 8 rows and 6 columns.
-3: Any one of rows 2–8 in the Internship Evaluation Form table does not contain merged cells.
